meta.name: product-marketing-copywriter
meta.description: 产品营销文案创作技能，支持多品类产品的吸引性营销文案生成，适用于产品推广、品牌营销、销售转化

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为产品生成吸引人的营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为产品撰写有吸引力的营销文案
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling marketing copy for your products
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write attractive marketing copy for your products

howto.what: 当用户请求营销文案创作时，Claude会收集产品信息、分析目标受众、提炼独特卖点，生成含标题、正文（引言、主体、结尾）和行动号召（CTA）的文案；也能对已有文案优化标题、正文、情感表达和CTA，并适当加入数据与客户评价。
howto.when: 当用户提出产品营销文案创作、文案优化或生成产品推广文案等需求时触发。

say.text: 为米其林智能厨电写一篇营销文案
say.note: 它会收集产品信息，按引言、主体、结尾输出标题、正文和CTA。

say.text: 帮我把这段文案的标题和行动号召改得更吸引人
say.note: 它会按优化流程检查并改进标题、正文和CTA。

say.text: 给绿色生活管家写文案，目标受众是年轻环保人群
say.note: 它会分析受众并匹配环保生活类模板。

howto.what_en: When activated, Claude gathers product info, analyzes audience, pinpoints USP, and writes copy with headline, body, and CTA; it can also optimize existing copy's headline, body, emotions, and CTA, backing claims with data and testimonials.
howto.when_en: When you ask for marketing copy creation, copy optimization, or promotional copy generation for a product.

say_en.text: Write marketing copy for Michelin smart kitchen appliances.
say_en.note: It gathers info and outputs headline, body, CTA.

say_en.text: Improve this copy's headline and call-to-action.
Write copy for Green Life Manager, targeting young eco-conscious users.
say_en.note: It analyzes audience and uses the eco template.
